description: Build a GPU simulation: 'reaction_diffusion' grows Gray-Scott patterns (via the validated recipe), while 'slime' and 'fluid' run a feedback loop displaced by an evolving noise flow field — drifting trails and advected smears. Exposes a Decay knob (trail persistence). For more procedural techniques (cellular automata, flow fields, strange attractors) see create_generative_art.

expose_controls.description: (slime/fluid) Expose a live 'Decay' knob bound to the gain Level TOP.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the self-contained simulation container is created inside.

speed.description: (slime/fluid) How fast the flow field evolves.

type.description: reaction_diffusion = Gray-Scott patterns (uses the validated recipe); slime = drifting decaying trails; fluid = advected smear.

name: create_simulation
title: Create simulation
